ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black pixels (approx 95% of visible fluke) to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels (approx 5% localized at tips and scars).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) distribution across the central and proximal surface area. High-intensity white contiguous clusters are restricted to the distal tips of both lobes, with sparse white linear pixel disruptions scattered across both surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior vertex and symmetrical depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular topography with several discrete valleys (indentations) on the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge appears smoother with smaller, higher-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve that sweeps upwards towards acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle scarring) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned white linear rake marks. Three prominent curved parallel lines on the upper right lobe and scattered straight lines on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring (rake marks) on the dorsal-facing ventral surfaces of both lobes; a deep indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approx. two-thirds distance from the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The stark contrast between the solid black fluke and the highly localized white pigment/scarring at the fluke tips creates a binary appearance at the distal extremities.
